title: 第25章 气海第26章 报名法赛和月考到来
content_zh:
“还有那个元阳灵根在天灵根里也很受欢迎，毕竟咱们学校里都是处男嘛，元阳灵根能够炼化处男体内的元阳精气为法力，提升法力的效果很厉害。”
赵天行自豪道“特别是我们高中的这道元阳灵根传了快二十年，经过一代代前辈把玩，其中沾染了成千上万名学生的元阳精气，更有一番玄妙之处。”
张羽听得眉头一皱，总觉得这元阳灵根听着很脏的样子，而且……
“大家不都绝育了吗？还能用这处男灵根？”
“是元阳灵根。”赵天行解释道“绝育手术只是暂时摘除了一些器官，但我们体内的元阳精气还是由肾脏处源源不绝的涌出，只是不会刺激我们的情感和精神了而已。”
“不然一届届长大后进行修复手术，重获新根的人又是怎么做到的。”
张羽一边走，一边继续问道“学校的天灵根里，有没有对法力提升帮助比较大的？”
赵天行闻言心中一动，回想着张羽最近的所作所为，心想着对方这段时间对提升法力的事情可真是够上心的。
“难道是为了参加法赛？”
赵天行想了想，说道“能辅助法力提升的灵根很多，我们学校里效果最好的应该就是气海灵根了，就是比较贵，不过你这次是免费奖励就无所谓价格了……”
气海灵根，外号穿墙王，最大优势是极大的覆盖范围，还能够穿越各种墙壁、建筑乃至大地的阻隔，进行大范围的灵机收摄，提高法力提炼的效率。
在听了赵天行的一番介绍后，张羽心中便已经决定要试试看这个天灵根了。
来到了静室一旁的灵根租凭办公室，张羽也没急着说出自己的目标，而是拿起桌上的介绍手册看了起来。
一旁的管理员是一名长着娃娃脸的女老师。
看见张羽的动作，她却是见缝插针地问道“同学，你是这里的会员吗？有没有熟悉的灵根？”
张羽头也不抬地说道“不是，没有。”
管理员连忙推荐道“我们现在有新会员充一万送一千的活动，同学你要试试吗？”
张羽“我是走神率0%奖励的天灵根租凭，我只拿奖励，其他没兴趣，你不用跟我推销了。”
管理员闻言无奈一笑，向后退去“那同学你有什么需要再跟我说。”
听着对方的说话，她便已经在张羽身上默默打了一个抠门的标签，失去了推销的兴趣。

张羽却不在乎对方怎么想的，他只是低下头，快速扫了一圈手册，发现上面写的和赵天行说的都差不多。
于是他向一旁的管理员说道“我想要租气海灵根。”
对方说道“学生卡扫一下。”
张羽拿出来自己的学生卡来递给了对方。
这张嵩阳高中的学生卡代表着他高中生的身份，是他平日里能够合法修仙，并享受各种仙路修行上的相关服务的重要凭证。
不一会，办公室里的管理员拿着一只玉盒送到了他的面前。
“气海灵根就在里面，你一会到里面的2号静室，打开玉匣，服下灵根就行了。”
“你租的时间是一个小时，时间从你进入静室的时间开始算，超时1分钟按1小时算，你自己看准时间出来……”
负责租凭业务的管理员又叮嘱了一番相关细节之后，便让张羽赶紧进去了。
一旁的赵天行“那张羽你先忙吧，我也要走了。”
张羽朝他点了点头“谢了。”
看着转身离去的张羽，赵天行心中不断回想着张羽的表情和语气，心道“这次跟他的关系应该是变更近了吧？”
content_en:
"Also, the Yuanyang Spiritual Root is also very popular among Tianlingen. After all, all the virgins in our school are virgins. The Yuanyang Spiritual Root can refine the Yuanyang essence in virgin bodies into mana, and the effect of increasing the mana is very powerful."
Zhao Tianxing said proudly, "Especially the Yuanyang spirit root in our high school has been passed down for almost twenty years. After generations of seniors have played with it, it has been contaminated with the Yuanyang essence of thousands of students, and it is even more mysterious."
Zhang Yu frowned when he heard this. He always felt that the Yuanyang Spiritual Root sounded very dirty, and...
"Hasn't everyone been sterilized? Can we still use this virgin spiritual root?"
"It's the Yuanyang spirit root." Zhao Tianxing explained, "The sterilization operation only temporarily removes some organs, but the Yuanyang essence in our body still flows out from the kidneys, but it will not stimulate our emotions and spirit."
"Otherwise, how would those who have had repair surgeries and regained new roots do it after growing up?"
As Zhang Yu walked away, he continued to ask, "Is there anyone among the Tianling roots in the school who can be more helpful in improving mana?"
Zhao Tianxing's heart moved when he heard this. He recalled Zhang Yu's recent actions and thought that the other party was really concerned about improving his magic power during this period.
"Is it to participate in the Fa competition?"
Zhao Tianxing thought for a while and said, "There are many spiritual roots that can assist in increasing mana. The most effective one in our school is probably the Qihai Spiritual Root. It is more expensive, but since you are getting a free reward this time, it doesn't matter the price..."
The biggest advantage of the Qi Sea Spiritual Root, nicknamed the Wall-Penetrating King, is its huge coverage area. It can also penetrate various walls, buildings and even the earth's barriers to capture a wide range of spiritual energy and improve the efficiency of mana refining.
After listening to Zhao Tianxing's introduction, Zhang Yu had already decided to give this Tianling Root a try.
Arriving at the Linggen Rental Office next to the quiet room, Zhang Yu was not in a hurry to tell his goal, but picked up the introduction brochure on the table and read it.
The administrator on the side is a female teacher with a baby face.
Seeing Zhang Yu's movements, she took every opportunity to ask, "Classmate, are you a member here? Do you have any familiar spiritual roots?"
Zhang Yu said without raising his head, "No, no."
The administrator quickly recommended, "We now have an event where new members can top up 10,000 and get 1,000 free. Do you want to try it, classmate?"
Zhang Yu: "I am a Tianlinggen tenant with a 0% distraction rate. I only get the rewards and have no interest in anything else. You don't have to sell me."
The administrator smiled helplessly when he heard this and stepped back, "Then, classmate, if you need anything, tell me again."
Listening to the other party's words, she had silently labeled Zhang Yu as stingy and lost interest in sales.
Zhang Yu didn't care what the other party thought. He just lowered his head and quickly scanned the manual and found that what was written on it was similar to what Zhao Tianxing said.
So he said to the administrator on the side, "I want to rent Qi Hailinggen."
The other party said, "Scan your student card."
Zhang Yu took out his student card and handed it to the other party.
This Songyang High School student card represents his status as a high school student and is an important certificate that allows him to legally practice immortality and enjoy various services related to the path of immortality.
After a while, the administrator in the office brought a jade box to him.
"The spirit root of the sea of ​​qi is inside. You can go to the quiet room No. 2 inside, open the jade box, and take the spirit root."
"The time you rent is one hour, and the time starts from the time you enter the quiet room. If you exceed 1 minute, it will be counted as 1 hour. You can come out at your own time..."
After the administrator in charge of the rental business gave some more relevant details, he asked Zhang Yu to hurry in.
Zhao Tianxing on the side said, "Zhang Yu, please do your work first, I have to leave too."
Zhang Yu nodded to him, "Thank you."
Looking at Zhang Yu who turned to leave, Zhao Tianxing kept thinkingRecalling Zhang Yu's expression and tone, I thought to myself, "The relationship with him should be closer this time, right?"
